ruleUpdate: HPE Synergy Brocade FC switch modules never use inter-frame stacking cables across frames; every switch connects strictly northbound to SAN Fabric A/B via Access Gateway or Switch mode. Both P77653-B21 (64Gb, 12 internal + 12 external SFP56, 0 QSFP) and Q2E57A (32Gb/20, 12 internal + 8 external SFP28 + 2 QSFP) include 4x SW SFP transceivers in-box (R7M15A for 64Gb) and 0 fiber cables. Every active FC switch requires matching 1:1 OM4 LC/LC fiber cables (e.g. QK732A-QK737A) or MPO breakout cables (K2Q46A/K2Q47A on QSFP) covering both the 4 included-in-box optics and any added R7M15A/R7M16A or R6B12A/R6W26A expansion optics.
